body.name: typed state and intervention maps
body.construction: Split the augmented coordinates \(W=(C,X,Y)\) into observed coordinates \(W^o=(C,H,Y)\) and the residual coordinate \(W^u=(\ast,Z_s,\ast)\). Use \(\delta((c,h,y),(\ast,z,\ast))=(c,\delta_X(h,z),y)\), \(\widetilde\tau(c,x,y)=(c,(h,x),y)\), and \(\tau^o(c,x,y)=(c,h,y)\). For a hard intervention \(j\) on \(J\subseteq\{C,X,Y\}\), \(\omega(j)=(j^o,j^u)\) sends \(C=j_C\) and \(Y=j_Y\) to the same observed-coordinate surgeries, sends \(X=j_X\) to \(H=h\) and residual surgery \(Z_s=j_X\), and leaves every nonintervened coordinate unset.
